description: Defines the autograd engine interface and related classes for backpropagation, including task scheduling, queue management, and engine control functions.

classes.name: NodeTask
classes.description: Represents a task in the autograd engine, holding references to the graph node, inputs, and task metadata.

classes.name: CheckpointValidGuard
classes.description: RAII guard that manages the checkpoint validity state during autograd operations.

classes.name: ReadyQueue
classes.description: Manages a priority queue of NodeTasks, handling task scheduling and thread notification.

classes.name: Engine
classes.description: Core class implementing the autograd execution engine, managing task scheduling, thread pools, and backward computation.

methods.name: set_device
methods.description: Sets the current device for autograd operations.

methods.name: validate_outputs
methods.description: Validates the outputs and gradients for autograd.

methods.name: collect_input_metadata
methods.description: Collects metadata for inputs in the autograd graph.

methods.name: Engine::get_default_engine
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of the default autograd engine.

methods.name: Engine::execute
methods.description: Performs forward and backward passes on the autograd graph.

methods.name: Engine::execute_with_graph_task
methods.description: Executes a backward pass given a pre-constructed GraphTask.

methods.name: Engine::stop
methods.description: Stops the engine and its worker threads.

methods.name: Engine::thread_init
methods.description: Initializes a device thread for autograd processing.

methods.name: Engine::is_checkpoint_valid
methods.description: Checks if the current checkpoint state is valid.
